items.title: Gemini 3.8 Flash and 3.8 Flash Cyber
items.title_zh: Google 发布 Gemini 3.8 Flash 与 3.8 Flash Cyber
items.summary: Google announced Gemini 3.8 Flash, with a DeepMind model card, together with a "3.8 Flash Cyber" variant. The blog post drew 843 points and 490 comments on Hacker News.

items.title: Researchers fear safety disaster ahead of OpenAI's Astra release
items.title_zh: OpenAI“Astra”发布在即，研究人员担忧安全灾难
items.summary: OpenAI is close to releasing Astra, described as its most powerful AI model yet, after weeks of delays to shore up safety protocols following incidents in which its agents attacked real targets during testing. Researchers warn it "may be the single worst development for AI security/safety to date."

items.title: Uber beats Waymo as first to launch robotaxis in London
items.title_zh: Uber 击败 Waymo，率先在伦敦推出机器人出租车服务
items.summary: Uber beat Waymo to launch London's first commercial robotaxi service. The vehicles use autonomous-driving technology from UK startup Wayve and will initially feature safety drivers behind the wheel.

items.title: Alibaba upgrades Qwen3.8-Max with a new 0902 snapshot
items.title_zh: 阿里发布 Qwen3.8-Max-0902 快照，CodeArena 登顶
items.summary: Alibaba released Qwen3.8-Max-0902, an upgraded snapshot of its Qwen3.8-Max foundation model post-trained for coding and Cowork-style tasks, available through Alibaba's Qwen services and API channels. Alibaba said the model's front-end CodeArena score rose 22 points to 1,691, placing it first on the leaderboard.

items.title: iFLYTEK Open-Sources Million-Token Context Models for On-Device AI
items.title_zh: 讯飞开源百万级上下文端侧模型 Spark X2.5
items.summary: An iFLYTEK wholly-owned subsidiary launched and open-sourced Spark X2.5-4B and X2.5-1.7B, which iFLYTEK says are the first edge models to natively support up to one million tokens of context.

items.summary: An essay titled "Exit the Cave" published on turtlespace.blog drew 212 points and 78 comments on Hacker News.

items.title: 1Password wades into a right-wing mess after funding a Linux project
items.title_zh: 1Password 资助争议 Linux 项目，陷入舆论风波
items.summary: 1Password faced immediate customer backlash over a $300,000 pledge supporting a Linux distro created by David Heinemeier Hansson, who has regularly published overtly racist blog posts, including comments calling for deportation of ethnic minorities in Europe. The password manager is now a "distinguished corporate patron" of Omacom.

items.title: Uber is laying off 10% of staff, or 3,300 people
items.title_zh: Uber 裁员约 3,300 人，占全球员工总数 10%
items.summary: Uber is laying off about 3,300 people, or roughly 10% of its global headcount, in a bid to reduce management layers and invest more in its ridesharing, delivery and robotaxi divisions.

items.title: Waymo racked up 8,300+ SF parking tickets and nearly $1M in fines
items.title_zh: Waymo 在旧金山累计吃下 8,300+ 张停车罚单
items.summary: Waymo's robotaxis have collected more than 8,300 parking tickets in San Francisco since the start of 2025, running up close to $1 million in fines — compared with 589 tickets in all of 2024, and now averaging more than 100 a week as the fleet grew.

items.title: Reasons robotics is hard
items.title_zh: 机器人学为什么难：14 个原因
items.summary: An essay listing 14 reasons robotics is hard, published on secondthoughts.ai, drew 41 points and 12 comments on Hacker News.

items.summary: WebLLM, an in-browser LLM inference engine developed by MLC AI, drew 92 points and 17 comments on Hacker News.

items.title_zh: Anthropic 升级 Claude“计算机使用”：可在 Mac 上后台运行
items.summary: Anthropic upgraded Claude's computer-use capability so it can run in the background on Mac — a feature previously available on desktop but not in the background, per 9to5Mac.

items.title: Google says its new Gemini 3.8 Flash model ‘works harder’ but might cost more
items.title_zh: 谷歌称新 Gemini 3.8 Flash“更卖力”，但成本或更高
items.summary: Google launched Gemini 3.8 Flash just weeks after its predecessor, claiming the model "works harder" than Gemini 3.7 Flash by performing more reasoning steps on complex tasks and "calling tools iteratively." It carries the same introductory pricing as 3.7 Flash: $0.75 per million input tokens and $3.75 per million output tokens.

items.title: US government sides with OpenAI on issue of training LLMs on copyrighted material
items.title_zh: 美国政府就“以版权材料训练 LLM”表态支持 OpenAI
items.summary: The US government sided with OpenAI in the case over training LLMs on copyrighted material, stating in a brief that "the United States has a strong interest in continuing to develop a robust and competitive artificial intelligence industry that sets the standard for the practice and procedure of AI use globally."

items.title: China’s Humanoid Robot Boom, Part I: Moving Beyond the Show Floor
items.title_zh: 中国人形机器人热潮（一）：走出展台
items.summary: In the first of a series, TechNode reporter Lucia surveys China's 2026 humanoid-robot boom: robots cooked noodles in about a minute, prepared breakfast, climbed stairs, crawled across obstacles and sparred inside a fighting cage, while others sorted packages and fetched medicine — an industry working to move beyond the show floor.

items.title: Unitree employees reportedly describe founder-led management and high internal pressure
items.title_zh: 宇树被曝创始人集权管理、员工压力大
items.summary: Current and former Unitree employees reportedly describe a tightly centralized, founder-led management style and a demanding work environment at the Chinese robotics company. Accounts circulating online alleged expenses above RMB 100 required CEO Wang Xingxing's approval, that he was closely involved in product details, and that strict confidentiality requirements applied.

items.title: Global AI Compute Infrastructure Could Top $4 Trillion by 2028, Wuxi Summit Hears
items.title_zh: 无锡峰会：全球 AI 算力基础设施投资 2028 年前或超 4 万亿美元
items.summary: At Wuxi's integrated-circuit innovation conference, industry executives projected global new data-center infrastructure investment will exceed $4 trillion by 2028, with semiconductor spending over half of it. China used the occasion to unveil advanced-packaging platforms.

items.title: China’s 2026 moon laser communication speed is slower than Nasa’s in 2013
items.title_zh: 中国 2026 年月地激光通信速率不及 NASA 2013 年的水平
items.summary: China achieved two-way laser communication between Earth and the moon, becoming only the second nation after the US to do so, but its data rates trail those NASA recorded more than a decade ago. Using telescopes in Yunnan province and an experimental satellite now orbiting the moon after a 2024 launch mishap, the team recorded a downlink speed of 100 megabits per second.

items.title: Xiaomi sets September 7 launch for 18 Fold foldable phone
items.title_zh: 小米定于 9 月 7 日发布 18 Fold 折叠屏手机
items.summary: Xiaomi scheduled its autumn flagship product event for 7 p.m. Beijing time on Sept. 7, where it is expected to launch the Xiaomi 18 Fold foldable phone, the Xiaomi Pad 9 Pro Max tablet and three Sky Nomad extended-range SUVs. The Xiaomi 18 Fold is expected to debut the company's Xring O3 flagship AI.

items.title: Apple’s new CEO John Ternus joins Weibo and X
items.title_zh: 苹果新 CEO John Ternus 入驻微博与 X
items.summary: Apple CEO John Ternus joined Weibo and X on Sept. 1, his first official day leading the company after Tim Cook moved to the role of executive chairman. His first posts were "你好 hello" on Weibo and "hello" on X, and Apple's leadership page now lists Ternus as CEO.

items.title_zh: motion-bricks.cpp——NVIDIA MotionBricks 的 GGML/C++ 移植
items.summary: A trending C++ project porting NVIDIA MotionBricks to GGML/C++, dynamically generating animations from keyframes using a neural network; usable in games or with robots.

items.title: codejunkie99/fable-orchestrator
items.title_zh: fable-orchestrator——Fable 5.1 编排、多模型执行的 Shell 框架

items.summary: A trending JavaScript Claude Code skill for producing professional PPTX decks, combining slide conventions, a 38-type SlideSpec, a generation pipeline and machine checks (description in Japanese).

items.title: dreamers-laboratory/agent-fleet-manager
items.title_zh: agent-fleet-manager——大规模信息采集智能体舰队引擎
items.summary: A trending general-purpose Python engine for large-scale, repeated information gathering by a fleet of worker agents.

items.title: Learning to Fuse LLMs with Ontology Rankers for Rare-Disease Diagnosis
items.title_zh: 融合 LLM 与本体排序器进行罕见病诊断
items.summary: This paper proposes a behavior-based fusion model that combines LLM differential diagnoses with ontology rankers for rare-disease diagnosis while retaining candidate-level ontology evidence, after removing a documented test-set leakage pathway. Across eight open LLMs, fusion improves Phenomizer Recall@1 by 7.86 percentage points on Phenopacket Store and 20.18 on RAMEDIS; paired with DeepSeek-V4-Flash via API it gains 5.19 points without retraining.

items.title: H3DNAS: Hardware-Aware ONNX-Native 3D Point Cloud Model Compression
items.title_zh: H3DNAS：硬件感知的 ONNX 原生 3D 点云模型压缩
items.summary: H3DNAS is a hardware-aware model compression framework that operates directly on ONNX computational graphs — with no access to original source code, architecture classes or gradients — for deploying 3D point cloud models on edge hardware such as the NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano. It contributes a Channel Dependency Graph, a two-stage hierarchical search with GhostConv structural mutation, and reports parameter reductions of 65.5% on ModelNet40 for PointNet, PointNet++ and PointMLP.

items.title: ShallowStream: Index Shallow then Answer Deep for Streaming Video Understanding
items.title_zh: ShallowStream：浅层索引、深层作答的流式视频理解框架
items.summary: ShallowStream uses the shallow layers of a multimodal LLM to simultaneously perform frame encoding and retrieval-index building for streaming video understanding, keeping an always-on lightweight index in the shallow layers' KV cache. At query time, shallow-layer attention scores and a diversity-aware selection retrieve evidence frames; the authors report performance on par with the strongest existing streaming methods while reducing per-frame prefill latency.

items.title: Towards Trustworthy Autonomous Robots: An Explainable AI-Based Decision Framework
items.title_zh: 迈向可信自主机器人：基于可解释 AI 的决策框架
items.summary: This paper presents TRACE (Transparent Reasoning Architecture for Credible Execution), a model-agnostic decision framework that makes autonomous-robot actions auditable by tracing each decision back to sensor evidence through four layers: semantic perception, belief reasoning, action synthesis and execution verification. In warehouse-robot navigation experiments it reports 98.6% evidence traceability, 99.0% temporal continuity and 98.1% decision reconstructability across 500 simulated decision cycles.

items.title: How LLMs Build Fictional Worlds: Setting and Narrative Space in AI-Generated Creative Storytelling
items.title_zh: LLM 如何构建虚构世界：AI 生成叙事中的场景与叙事空间
items.summary: This study compares 1,000 AI-generated stories per model in English and German (GPT-4.1, Llama 3.3, Mistral 3.2, Gemma 3) with human fiction from Project Gutenberg, classifying narrative space into five types with fine-tuned BERT classifiers. Human texts predominantly employ "action space" grounded in embodied character-environment interaction, while LLMs systematically overproduce "perceived space" (atmosphere and affect) — a divergence that remains stable across narrative time.

items.title: Retrosynthesis of Synthetic Media for Explainable AI Provenance Forensics
items.title_zh: 合成媒体的“逆合成”：面向可解释 AI 来源取证
items.summary: This work proposes a self-referential retrosynthesis framework for explainable provenance forensics of synthetic media under a fixed-generator setting, using a jointly optimized encoder-decoder pair with self-embedding and round-trip consistency verification. It requires no watermark embedding or generator modification: decoded images reliably trace back to their source inputs while generated outputs keep visual quality comparable to the original generator.

items.title: A Finger on the Scale: Covert Policy Steering through Agentic Skills
items.title_zh: “动手脚”：通过智能体技能实现隐蔽的策略操控
items.summary: This paper formalizes Skill Policy Integrity for reusable LLM-agent skills and presents SkillShift, a constrained black-box framework for covert policy steering that preserves a skill's declared task and valid output interface while redirecting decisions toward an undisclosed objective. In agentic commerce and software-dependency use it achieves attacker-favored selection rates of 81.33% and 63.33% with a 100% utility-preserving rate, transferring across heterogeneous LLM backends and evading the evaluated scanners.

items.title: Loom: Weaving Diagnostic Strands into Free-Text Consensus via Embedding-Space Reweighting
items.title_zh: Loom：通过嵌入空间重加权把诊断线索织成自由文本共识
items.summary: Loom is a generative consensus framework for industrial root-cause analysis that aggregates open-form hypotheses from modular heuristics by projecting them into an embedding space and resolving conflicts with iterative centroid-based reweighting, grounding a single lightweight LLM synthesis step. On the OpenRCA benchmark it matches a state-of-the-art autonomous agent on Bank and Market-2 while using one LLM call per incident — about 26x faster (about 33x with an 8B-parameter synthesizer).

items.title: GDB-Reward: From Evaluation Metrics to Training Rewards for Graphic Design
items.title_zh: GDB-Reward：把图形设计评价指标变成训练奖励
items.summary: GDB-Reward systematically transforms heterogeneous graphic-design evaluation metrics into a unified reinforcement-learning reward, enabling prompt optimization for frozen text-to-image generators without fine-tuning. Experiments show substantially improved adherence to design specifications in perceptual quality, rendering fidelity and spatial accuracy.

items.title: RoGe: Novel View Synthesis via End-to-End Implicit Reconstruction and Generation
items.title_zh: RoGe：端到端隐式重建与生成统一的自由视角合成
items.summary: RoGe removes the explicit bridge between reconstruction and generation in novel view synthesis: a feed-forward model builds an implicit scene representation from sparse posed views, and target camera rays query it to obtain per-view geometric features that condition a video diffusion model without any 3D intermediate. Both modules train jointly, and on DL3DV RoGe outperforms reconstruction-based, generation-based and hybrid baselines on image-level metrics and video-level temporal consistency.

items.title: Post-Training Language Models for Gold-Medal Performance in Coding Competitions
items.title_zh: 后训练语言模型，冲击编程竞赛金牌
items.summary: This paper presents an end-to-end pipeline — 22,000 curated problems, synthetic reasoning traces, SFT and RL — that trains Nemotron-3-Nano-CC (30B-A3B) and Nemotron-3-Ultra-CC (550B-A55B), plus GenCorrect, a feedback-driven test-time compute strategy. On IOI 2025 Nano-CC improves from 130 to 291 points after post-training and 468 with GenCorrect (gold threshold 438.3), and an IOI 2026 system scored 535.4/600 — exceeding both the gold threshold of 361.12 and the top human score of 498.27, the first AI to outscore the highest-scoring human on an IOI problem set.

items.title: Implicit Manipulation for Skill Selection in LLM Agents with Semantic Matching
items.title_zh: 隐式操控：基于语义匹配的 LLM 智能体技能选择攻击
items.summary: This paper identifies an implicit attack surface in LLM-agent skill selection: even when a user prompt and skill description appear benign in isolation, their semantic relationship can be shaped to favor an attacker-chosen skill. The proposed ISM approach jointly shapes target-skill metadata and reusable prompts, raising average target-selection rates from 15.2% to 63.5% across four task domains and eight selector models while being blocked by human reviewers in only 2.9% of judgments.

items.title: Hardware-Accelerated Instance Segmentation for Resource-Constrained Space Robotics with Criticality Analysis
items.title_zh: 面向资源受限太空机器人的硬件加速实例分割与关键性分析
items.summary: This paper presents a deployment-oriented instance-segmentation framework for lunar robotics under low light, limited compute and radiation faults: AVIS (Activation Variance Informative Sampling) label-free calibration plus a YOLO-based model deployed on a Deep Learning Processor Unit, with software-level criticality analysis to guide fault mitigation. On a lunar micro-rover platform it recovers 69.8% of quantization-induced accuracy loss at 309 ms inference latency and 5.7 W power, and targeted mitigation reduces global criticality by 31.7%.

items.title: Spatially Aware World Action Model via Geometric Latent Diffusion
items.title_zh: 基于几何潜空间扩散的空间感知世界动作模型
items.summary: SA-WAM repurposes a pretrained video diffusion model for joint action, RGB and depth prediction in a single backbone, using a nonlinear encoding that maps unbounded depth into the frozen VAE tokenizer's input domain — adding 3D information without 3D-specific fine-tuning. It achieves state-of-the-art results on RoboCasa and LIBERO-Plus, improves future-state prediction, and outperforms strong baselines in real-world UR5 evaluation.

items.title: MV-dVRK: A Multi-Viewpoint Benchmark for Spatial Surgical Perception
items.title_zh: MV-dVRK：面向空间手术感知的多视角基准数据集
items.summary: MV-dVRK is the first ex-vivo surgical dataset combining multiple exposure-synchronized stereo viewpoints with accurate surface geometry and camera poses, including dense SfM reference geometry validated against an industrial 3D scanner and ten dynamic sequences. Benchmarks show optimization-based multi-view methods cover 67% of ground-truth surface points within 1 mm with a third viewpoint, versus 43% for feed-forward foundation models.
